**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Fence the project context after an authorization refusal**

When membership is revoked and the list, current transcript, or a direct probe returns the new definitive 403, `fenced` removes the rows and thread but this unconditional `ProjectContext` remains mounted. Its React Query read retains the previous `MissionContext` on a failed refetch, so cached mission, accepted/pending decision text, and A08 controls can remain visible indefinitely if subsequent context or snapshot reads fail; include this pane in the same synchronous render gate until a post-refusal authorization read succeeds.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Fence every consumer of the shared context cache**

When the New conversation form was open before a refusal, a later successful list read remounts it while this post-refusal context read is still pending or has failed. This freshness check protects only `ProjectContext`; `NewConversation.tsx:66-67` consumes the same cached query without checking `refusedAt` or `readFrom`, so its “Start from what’s still open” buttons reveal the pre-refusal pending-decision text again, indefinitely if the new context read fails. Apply the refusal freshness gate to all consumers of `contextQuery`, not only this pane.
